name: Corpse Party: BloodCovered (Visual Novel)
source:
A group of high school students perform a charm -Sachiko Ever After- that transports them to a cursed school called Heavenly Host. Discover the insides of this building while you try to escape. Who will survive?

This is a fangame created by MadnessWay Games, in which you can play a remake of the PSP game Corpse Party: BloodCovered, but in visual novel style.

[From [url=https://madnessway.itch.io/corpse-party-bloodcovered-visual-novel]itch.io[/url]]
